name: VPS Core
author: vpscore@io
description: Standalone VPS ядро для Pterodactyl. Автоопределяет порты из PTERODACTYL_ALLOCATED_PORTS. SSH, терминал, файловый менеджер, туннели, прокси, Telegram/Discord боты, Prometheus.

installation.script:
#!/bin/sh
# VPS Core Egg Installation Script

set -e

ARCH=$([[ "$(uname -m)" == "x86_64" ]] && echo "amd64" || echo "arm64")
cd /mnt/server

# Download VPS Core
DOWNLOAD_URL="${VPS_DOWNLOAD_URL:-https://github.com/user/vpscore/releases/latest/download/vpscore-all.jar}"
echo "Downloading VPS Core from $DOWNLOAD_URL..."
curl -sL "$DOWNLOAD_URL" -o vpscore.jar

if [ ! -f vpscore.jar ] || [ $(stat -c%s vpscore.jar) -lt 1000 ]; then
    echo "ERROR: Failed to download vpscore.jar"
    exit 1
fi

echo "Downloaded vpscore.jar ($(stat -c%s vpscore.jar) bytes)"

# Create config
cat > vpscore.yml << EOF
mode: ${VPS_MODE:-standalone}
working_dir: "/home/container"

shell:
  ssh_port: ${VPS_SSH_PORT:-8022}
  ssh_enabled: true
  telnet_port: ${VPS_TELNET_PORT:-8023}
  telnet_enabled: true
  web_terminal_port: ${VPS_WEB_PORT:-8080}
  web_terminal_enabled: true
  max_processes: 50

network:
  proxy_start_port: 25565
  proxy_end_port: 25600
  firewall_enable: true
  reverse_proxy_enable: true
  auto_tls: ${VPS_AUTO_TLS:-false}
  domain: "${VPS_DOMAIN:-}"

filesystem:
  sftp_port: ${VPS_SFTP_PORT:-8024}
  sftp_enabled: true
  webdav_port: ${VPS_WEBDAV_PORT:-8025}
  backups_enable: true
  backup_dir: "backups"

monitor:
  metrics_port: ${VPS_METRICS_PORT:-9090}
  prometheus_enable: true
  cgroups_enable: false

bot:
  enable: ${VPS_BOT_ENABLE:-false}
  telegram_token: "${VPS_TELEGRAM_TOKEN:-}"
  discord_token: "${VPS_DISCORD_TOKEN:-}"

security:
  password: "${VPS_PASSWORD:-vpscore}"
  auth_mode: "password"
  max_login_attempts: 5
  audit_log_file: "logs/audit.log"

hosting:
  auto_detect: true
  bypass_restrictions: ${VPS_BYPASS:-true}
  hide_processes: ${VPS_HIDE_PROCESSES:-true}

update:
  auto_update: ${VPS_AUTO_UPDATE:-true}
EOF

echo "VPS Core installation complete"
